text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing hematuria and right flank pain; can you describe exactly when these symptoms started and how severe the pain is?

speaker: Patient
text: 42-year-old Caucasian male. The patient reports experiencing visible blood in his urine accompanied by discomfort in his right flank. He denies any recent trauma to the area. He mentions a series of urinary tract infections over the past few years but has not been on renal dialysis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Renal Cell Carcinoma (RCC).

While the patient's history of recurrent UTIs is noted, the age, gender, and presentation of gross hematuria with flank pain are classic indicators for a renal malignancy. I need to confirm this suspicion with imaging and labs immediately. REQUEST TEST: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with contrast. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with microscopy and urine cytology.
